The Kia EV5

The Kia EV5 Exterior Features

A confident new face

With its wide dimensions and dynamic contours, the EV5’s front styling expresses both power and sophistication. Robust details meet refined design, anchored by Kia’s Digital Tiger Face and distinctive Star Map lighting, giving the EV5 a unique identity that’s instantly recognisable.

Unified style, front to back

Every detail of the EV5’s rear design is a unison of strength and sophistication. From the sculpted, downward-shaped spoiler that guides airflow, to the integrated hidden wiper for a cleaner look, the design feels seamless. The Star Map taillights connect the front and back with one cohesive high-tech signature.

Silhouette with dynamic strength

The EV5’s profile balances elegance with solidity. Sculpted side garnishes reinforce its robust character, while the clean, flush handles add a futuristic edge. A high shoulder line connects front headlights and rear taillights in one bold sweep that appears as a floating roof line. Complemented by an extended rear section that provides more space inside.

Precision-crafted alloy wheels

Every EV5 trim is matched with its own alloy wheel design. Offered in 18" and 19" sizes, each features a precision-machined finish with black high-gloss detailing, enhancing both the road stance and refined look of the EV5.

Approved Used BMW & MINI

All Approved Used Cars will come with the following:

Minimum 12 month unlimited mileage warranty

Verified service history

Vehicle history and mileage check

Minimum 12 month Roadside Assistance

Minimum 12 months MOT cover

BMW & MINI Used Cars

BMW Used Cars share all of the Approved Used Car Benefits however may not meet BMW's Approved Used Car servicing standards and therefore are sold without a verified service history. All vehicles undergo the same meticulous checks as an Approved Used Car and will have a comprehensive service completed before reaching the forecourt. For more details, contact your local Halliwell Jones BMW or MINI Centre.
